description: This file defines a centralized Vitest mock type for harness modules under `src/`. It uses TypeScript's type aliasing and imports from the 'vitest' testing library to create a generic mock function type that helps avoid exporting inferred `vi.fn()` types.

ctags.name: MockFn
ctags.pattern: /^export type MockFn<T extends (...args: any[]) => any = (...args: any[]) => any> =$/
